title: Initiation of lenacapavir with dose escalation in a patient receiving rifabutin: A case report with therapeutic drug monitoring.
what: Lenacapavir is a first-in-class HIV-1 capsid inhibitor with long-acting pharmacokinetics that enable 6-monthly subcutaneous dosing after initiation with oral lead-in. Lenacapavir is a CYP3A4, UGT1A1 and P-gp substrate; inducers of these enzymes and P-gp can significantly decrease lenacapavir concentrations.
why: Dose escalation maintains therapeutic lenacapavir levels despite rifabutin induction
pkpd_hook: Cmax of 245.7 ng/mL, projected Cmin of 19.5 ng/mL at 6 months
source: PubMed, British journal of clinical pharmacology
original_title: Initiation of lenacapavir with dose escalation in a patient receiving rifabutin: A case report with therapeutic drug monitoring.
headline: Lenacapavir dose adjustment with rifabutin

title: Vitamine B6-tekort mogelijk bij levodopa met carbidopa
what: Een tekort aan vitamine B6 is een mogelijke bijwerking van levodopa met carbidopa tabletten. Bijwerkingencentrum Lareb ontving hierover 13 meldingen.
why: A possible side effect of levodopa-carbidopa tablets is a vitamin B6 deficiency, based on 13 reports to the Dutch pharmacovigilance centre.
pkpd_hook: No specific pharmacokinetic or pharmacodynamic point mentioned.

headline: Potential vitamin B6 deficiency with levodopa-carbidopa tablets
